Owner and stylist at the final cut hairdressing, Belfast for 28 years. Andrew began his hairdressing career in Dublin before moving to London in the early eighties to work in one of Londons top salons. Returning to Belfast in 1988, Andrew opened The Final Cut in October 1988. The aim was to provide high quality hairdressing at an affordable price in East Belfast.

Andrew also taught for 3 years and has several qualifications including a City and Guilds accredited NVQ level 3 in advanced hairdressing from the Belfast Institute (BIFHE) as well as his D32 and D33 assessor awards.
Nearly 30 years later, his philosophy is still the same, to evolve his clients hair in both condition and style, colouring and cutting is what sets him apart.

Puk has been with The Final Cut Hairdressing since 1998, a fully qualified hair stylist, Puk has chosen to specialize in creative commercial colouring, Puks specialist highlighting techniques are hard to beat when looking to create that perfect blonde or add depth and interest to a super cut. Puk excels in colouring, she has worked and trained extensively with wella colours and products throughout her career and has attended various wella and other courses to perfect her craft.

Louise joined The Final Cut in 2013, Louise has recently qualified and completed her NVQ Level 2 hairdressing and is currently working towards her advanced certificate NVQ Level 3. She is committed to customer service and her head massages are heavenly. Louise is interested in fashion and on trend colouring, including balayage and ombre styles.
"Had one of the best cuts ever, lovely surroundings and the staff are very attentive. I will definitely be back."

"I have never been anywhere else in the last 25 years. Love Andrew's ability to create a new and original style every 8 - 10 weeks and the craic in the salon is the best. Had another new creation today and I love the new colour and cut. Best in Belfast!"
